scope_purpose: The Engine scope covers the libraries and runtime services that power Conjure applications. Start with a module to understand its responsibilities, then follow its headers to the structures and classes that implement them.
module_purpose: The audio module mixes voices, routes them through a hierarchy of groups, spatialises them against a listener, and sends the resulting samples to a playback backend. It also supplies clip decoding, the audio clip asset type, and a deterministic null backend for headless applications and tests.
header_purpose: This header brings together construction settings, batched voice transforms, diagnostic counters, and the audio engine facade. Include it when constructing an audio engine directly, driving audio in a tool or test, or extending the application's audio integration. The engine owns its backend, mixer, voice table, groups, and listener; the small structures describe its inputs and observations.
header_summary: Construction settings, batched voice transforms, diagnostic counters, and the audio engine facade.

type_purposes.audio_settings: Construction settings for the audio engine, including backend selection, mix format, recovery policy, initial groups, and optional decoding jobs.
type_purposes.voice_transform: A voice identifier with its world-space position and velocity, used to submit several spatial updates together.
type_purposes.audio_engine_stats: A snapshot of voice, command, event, rendering, and device-recovery counters for diagnostics and profiling.
type_purposes.audio_engine: The audio facade that owns the backend, mixer, voices, group hierarchy, and listener, and coordinates them during each frame.

descriptions.audio_settings::backend: Requested backend. AUTO allows normal backend selection; NULL_BACKEND selects deterministic headless playback.
descriptions.audio_settings::sampleRate: Requested mix rate in Hz. validate() checks it against MIN_SAMPLE_RATE and MAX_SAMPLE_RATE.
descriptions.audio_settings::periodFrames: Requested number of frames per device callback; it must be non-zero.
descriptions.audio_settings::deviceName: Requested playback device name. An empty name selects the default device.
descriptions.audio_settings::masterGain: Initial gain for the master mix group.
descriptions.audio_settings::dopplerFactor: Doppler scale; zero disables the effect. The supported range is zero to ten.
descriptions.audio_settings::speedOfSound: Speed of sound used by Doppler calculations, in world-distance units per second.
descriptions.audio_settings::maxRecoveryAttempts: Number of failed restart attempts allowed before falling back to the null backend.
descriptions.audio_settings::groups: Groups created at construction. Their parents are resolved by name.
descriptions.audio_settings::jobs: Optional job system for streaming decode work. A null pointer runs decoding inline during update().
descriptions.voice_transform::velocity: World-space velocity used by spatial and Doppler calculations.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::activeVoices: Number of currently active voices in the mixer snapshot.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::peakVoices: Highest number of active voices observed.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::streamingVoices: Streaming slots currently tracked by the engine.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::voicesDropped: Playback requests dropped when a voice could not be admitted.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::commandsSpilled: Commands buffered outside the command ring when it was full.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::eventsReceived: Mixer events received on the main thread.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::eventsDropped: Mixer events dropped when the event ring overflowed.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::framesRendered: Total sample frames rendered by the mixer.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::loops: Loop completions recorded by the mixer.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::fellBackToNull: Whether backend recovery switched playback to the null backend.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::outputFormat: The mix output format negotiated at construction.
descriptions.audio_engine_stats::deviceState: Mirrored device state used for diagnostics, including LOST during recovery.
descriptions.audio_engine::mState: Private implementation state owning the mixer, command/event rings, voice and group tables, and backend.
